skill:packages/mdcode/skills/sync-markdo.reason: Extract section drops --ignore-anonymous, says blocks without file= are skipped, and describes --update-source as the only way they become block-<N> files; the 'plain extract on a README' mistake becomes 'extract --update-source on a README'.
